title: Set manual per-side solder mask on named pads
summary: Shows how to find pads by name and switch their solder mask expansion to manual with separate top and bottom values by editing and reassigning the pad cache, with a read-back command.
phrasings: override the solder mask expansion of a pad
set different top and bottom solder mask on pads
find all pads with a given name
use a manual solder mask instead of the design rule

commands.name: ChangePadSolderMask
commands.description: Set manual per-side solder mask on pads named M3

commands.name: ShowPadSolderMask
commands.description: Show the solder mask settings of pads named M3
